Incorporated in November 2016, Swara Baby Products Limited is a specialized contract manufacturer of disposable consumer hygiene products, offering a diversified portfolio across baby care, adult incontinence, and feminine hygiene categories. The company manufactures baby pant and tape-style diapers, adult diapers, sanitary napkins, panty liners, and related hygiene products for leading brands, while also marketing its own consumer brands, "Cuddles" (baby diapers) and "Shields" (adult diapers) through online and modern retail channels.

According to the TKC Report, Swara Baby Products was the largest contract manufacturer in India's hygiene manufacturing industry by value in Fiscal 2025, holding a 37% market share in baby diaper contract manufacturing and a 36% market share in adult diaper contract manufacturing. The company combines large-scale manufacturing capabilities with centralized R&D, quality assurance, and an efficient supply chain to deliver customized hygiene solutions. It further strengthened its product portfolio by entering the feminine hygiene segment through the acquisition of KAEHPL in December 2025.

The company operates strategically located manufacturing facilities supported by strong research, quality control, and an integrated supply chain.

As of March 31, 2026, Swara Baby Products employed 775 permanent personnel across production, quality, supply chain, finance, administration, HR, and IT functions.

Refer to Swara Baby Products IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

Incorporated in November 2016, Swara Baby Products Limited is a specialized contract manufacturer of disposable consumer hygiene products, offering a diversified portfolio across baby care, adult incontinence, and feminine hygiene categories. The company manufactures baby pant and tape-style diapers, adult diapers, sanitary napkins, panty liners, and related hygiene products for leading brands, while also marketing its own consumer brands, "Cuddles" (baby diapers) and "Shields" (adult diapers) through online and modern retail channels.

According to the TKC Report, Swara Baby Products was the largest contract manufacturer in India's hygiene manufacturing industry by value in Fiscal 2025, holding a 37% market share in baby diaper contract manufacturing and a 36% market share in adult diaper contract manufacturing. The company combines large-scale manufacturing capabilities with centralized R&D, quality assurance, and an efficient supply chain to deliver customized hygiene solutions. It further strengthened its product portfolio by entering the feminine hygiene segment through the acquisition of KAEHPL in December 2025.

The company operates strategically located manufacturing facilities supported by strong research, quality control, and an integrated supply chain.

As of March 31, 2026, Swara Baby Products employed 775 permanent personnel across production, quality, supply chain, finance, administration, HR, and IT functions.

Swara Baby Products Ltd.'s revenue increased by 26% and profit after tax (PAT) rose by 18% between the financial year ending with March 31, 2026 and March 31, 2025.

faqs.question: How to apply in Swara Baby Products IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Swara Baby Products IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Swara Baby Products IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Swara Baby Products IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .
